The image is described with the 4096-dimensional output from the last fully connected layer of the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), VGG16 BIBREF25 . The system performs an element-wise multiplication of the image and question features, after linearly transforming the image descriptor to 1024 dimensions. The final layer of the architecture is a softmax layer.
